rules.statement: Don't report an edit to a file as touching a template-owned file until you have checked whether the repository's `.copier-answers.yml` lists it under `project_owned_files` or AGENTS.md records it as a project override; if either does, the edit is allowed.
rules.why: Files named in `project_owned_files` are left alone by template updates, so editing them is safe and expected. A finding that ignores this is a false positive.
rules.check: Before flagging an edit to a file the conventions call template-owned (e.g. `build/dod.ps1`), open `.copier-answers.yml` and look for it under `project_owned_files`, and search AGENTS.md for a recorded override. Report only if neither lists it.

rules.statement: Don't report a decision-record citation removed from a `///` doc comment as a lost link until you have checked the whole member and file for an existing `// See ADR-NNNN.` comment that already cites the same record.
rules.why: The convention moves citations out of doc comments into `//` comments, and lets a `///` citation be dropped when a `//` comment on that member already cites it, so the link to the decision record is kept.
rules.check: When a diff removes an ADR reference from a `///` summary without adding a `//` citation, search the unchanged parts of the file, especially the lines just above the declaration, for a `// See ADR-NNNN.` naming the same ADR. Report only if there isn't one.
